# Foreword

This is a short foreword paragraph. It has two sentences.
%%CHAPTER%%
# The Beginning

It was a quiet morning. The station was empty.

A single train waited on the far platform. Its lights were still on.
%%CHAPTER%%
# The Middle

Nothing much happened here for a while. Then something did.

It rained for three days straight. People stayed inside and read books.
%%CHAPTER%%
# The End

At last the train departed. The platform was quiet again.
